scope: All local raster/vector image files under assets; inline SVG icons are excluded. An inventory record is not a claim that its artwork credit is verified.

statusDefinitions.verified_credit: Artwork identified and the named artist role corroborated by a publisher cover credit. This does not mean every contributor, local edition, colorist or original download is known; see remainingGaps.
statusDefinitions.source_matched: Artwork visually matched to a publisher reference, but specific cover contributor roles still need confirmation.
statusDefinitions.unresolved: The exact artwork source or edition has not been established. A filename, character creator, signature or generic DC attribution is not sufficient.

rightsNote: Provenance and credit records do not grant a license or imply permission from the rights holder. No new AI artwork was added.

homepage-corps.gap: Existing reseller/news/wallpaper attributions do not identify the original issue, panel, variant or artist. These remain unresolved.

characters.gap: The character creator or a biography source is not a portrait credit. Match the exact illustration before attributing it.

entities.gap: Generic DC attribution does not identify the exact panel, cover or contributors. All eight need further provenance work.
